title: PandasCorpus: A Resource of Real-World Pandas Workflows and Usage Patterns
abstract: arXiv:2608.14742v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pandas has emerged as the de facto library for data processing and machine learning, widely used for tasks, such as data loading, transformation, and analysis. Despite its ubiquity, there has been limited systematic investigation into how Pandas is used in real-world projects and how typical workflows are composed in practice. To address this gap, we introduce PandasCorpus, a dataset curated from GitHub repositories that captures real-world Pandas workflows at scale. In this work, a workflow refers to Pandas-based code contained in Jupyter notebooks, a prevalent medium for writing, executing, and sharing data analysis code.   The dataset comprises 139k notebooks from approximately 100k repositories and captures more than 4M Pandas API calls spanning 136 distinct operations. Beyond dataset construction, we characterize workflows using structural and Pandas-specific features and analyze notebook evolution between 2015 and 2025. Our study

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14742v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：Pandas已成为数据处理和机器学习的事实标准库，广泛用于数据加载、转换和分析等任务。尽管其普遍存在，但对Pandas在真实世界项目中的使用方式以及典型工作流在实践中如何组合的系统性研究仍然有限。为填补这一空白，我们引入了PandasCorpus，这是一个从GitHub仓库中整理的数据集，大规模捕获真实世界的Pandas工作流。在本研究中，工作流指Jupyter笔记本中包含的基于Pandas的代码，而Jupyter笔记本是编写、执行和共享数据分析代码的常见媒介。该数据集包含来自约10万个仓库的13.9万个笔记本，捕获了超过400万次Pandas API调用，涵盖136种不同操作。除数据集构建外，我们使用结构性和Pandas特定特征来表征工作流，并分析了2015年至2025年间笔记本的演变。我们的研究...
tldr: 该论文构建了PandasCorpus数据集，从GitHub的13.9万个Jupyter笔记本中捕获超过400万次Pandas API调用，系统分析了真实世界Pandas工作流的结构特征和十年演变模式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PandasCorpus, a dataset of 139k Jupyter notebooks from GitHub capturing over 4 million Pandas API calls, systematically analyzing structural characteristics and decade-long evolution patterns of real-world Pandas workflows.
